help: Your full body in VR: its size and posture, the Pip-Boy, the flashlight, two-handed weapons, and smooth movement.

content.text: FRIK brings the full player body to life in VR! FRIK aims to bring the same level of immersion of having your body visible to Fallout 4 VR. Full body Inverse Kinematics has been implemented to animate the arms and legs based on your controller and HMD position.

content.help: Opens FRIK help wiki in your browser. Switch to your desktop monitor to read it.
